answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> The Holy Quran Question ID: 3390 Country: ZA Title: In the recent past, many egyptian quraa have been coming to our shores, and one noticable feature of all of these quraa is that they have clean shaven faces, or trimmed beards well below the stipulated 1 fist. Is it then correct for us to listen to these quraa? And more especially reknown ulema and quraa also attending? And keep in mind the fact that even the tones in which the recite closely resemble muscial tones. Please advise. Question: Asalaamualaikum Respected Mufti Saaheb In the recent past, many egyptian quraa have been coming to our shores, and one noticable feature of all of these quraa is that they have clean shaven faces, or trimmed beards well below the stipulated 1 fist. Is it then correct for us to listen to these quraa? And more especially reknown ulema and quraa also attending? And keep in mind the fact that even the tones in which the recite closely resemble muscial tones. Please advise. Answer ID: 3390 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 392/345=B) It is allowed to listen qir?ah , but how have you decided that they recite the Quran in musical tone? Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
